content: First-cut designs simulated: id=1 (reward=-0.844, gain=670.6, noise=0.0205, SR=28.18, PM=31.89, UGBW=29.8MHz, current=176.4uA) and id=2 (reward=-0.920, gain=114.1, PM=51.49, UGBW=32.1MHz). Hand analysis showed id=1 is limited by 2nd pole p2=gm6/(2pi CL)=17.9MHz and RHP zero at 1.5GHz. Candidate 1 is the best base. Recommend diagnoser to boost gm6 and push zero into LHP while preserving gain by keeping ln1>=90nm.

Best id=1. Binding spec: ugbw (-0.541, 29.8MHz) and phm (-0.306, 31.9deg). OP evidence: p2=gm6/(2pi CL)=17.94MHz << UGBW, 1/gm6=887ohm > Rc=800ohm (RHP zero). All devices in saturation. Chosen lever: boost gm6 via wider mp3 (and matching mp1 for balance), increase tail/second-stage mirror ratios (mn4, mn5) to fix slew rate (28.2->32V/us), and raise Rc (>1/gm6) to move zero into LHP for phase boost. Cc reduced slightly to 1.0pF.

Simulated id=3 (reward=-0.651, PM 42.4), id=4 (cap 0.8pF, reward=-0.639, SR=37.9V/us feasible, UGBW 41.2MHz), and sweep res 1500..4000 ohm (best id=10, res=4000, reward=-0.336). Result: PM reached 60.76 deg (feasible!), slew rate is 38.3 V/us (feasible), current is 177.8 uA (feasible). Only violation remaining is ugbw=46.42MHz (target 100MHz).

Best id=10. Binding spec: ugbw (46.4MHz vs 100MHz). All other specs feasible (PM 60.8, SR 38.3, gain 740, current 177.8uA). OP evidence: p2=gm6/(2pi CL)=22.95MHz limits UGBW; gm1/(2pi Cc)=96.1MHz. Chosen lever: widen mp3 (12->20) with mp1 (6->10) for balance to boost gm6 and p2; widen mn1 (8->14) to boost gm1; reduce Cc (0.8pF->0.5pF) to push gm1/(2pi Cc) > 150MHz.

Simulated id=11 (mp3=20, mp1=10, mn1=14, reward=-0.294), id=12 (cap=0.5pF, reward=-0.324, UGBW=60.2MHz), sweep res 4500..7000 (best id=18, res=7000, reward=-0.1315). Result: UGBW surged to 73.8 MHz, PM reached 59.21 deg (almost 60), SR=51.9V/us, current=179.5uA. Res increase gives continuous monotonic gain in PM and UGBW.

Best id=18. Binding specs: ugbw (73.8MHz vs 100MHz, norm -0.151) and phm (59.2 deg vs 60 deg, norm -0.007). All other specs well within margin (gain 776, SR 51.9, current 179.5uA, area 7.2e-10). OP: zero=49.8MHz, gm1/(2pi Cc)=159.4MHz. Lever: sweep res 7500..9500 to push PM past 60 deg, then reduce Cc to 0.4pF to push UGBW to 100MHz.

FEASIBLE design achieved! id=28, FoM=0.6312. Specs: gain=767.7, noise=0.0164, phm=60.73 deg, slewRate=41.13 V/us, ugbw=102.7 MHz, current=200uA, area=1.005e-9 m^2. Changes from base: cap=0.8pF, res=9500ohm, mp3=24, mp1=10, mn1=14, mn5=12. Phase 1 complete. Handing over to phase 2 (optimization).

Feasible mode: best id=28 (FoM=0.6312). Gain (768 vs 200) and SR (41.1 vs 30) have excess margin; PM (60.7 deg) and UGBW (102.7 MHz) are close to binding. Chosen lever: reduce mn1 from 14 to 12 to reduce gate area and test if UGBW stays >= 100MHz. If margins break, hand over to RL strategist for multi-parameter Pareto optimization.

Phase 2 optimization: id=29 (mn1=12, FoM=0.6333), id=30 (mn1=10, FoM=0.6355), id=31 (mn1=8, FoM=0.6379, best feasible: gain=757, phm=63.97, ugbw=101.4MHz, current=199uA, area=9.95e-10m^2). id=32 (res=9000) dropped UGBW to 97.7MHz (infeasible). Single-parameter hand tuning has stalled; hand over to RL strategist.

RL phase 3 completed: 700 simulations used (100 warmup + 600 training). Best design improved from id=31 (FoM=0.6379) to id=445 (FoM=0.6528). Replay buffer now contains 57 feasible designs. Key parameter changes from expert best: mn3: 3->4, mn4: 5->7, mn5: 12->14, wn5: 1.0u->1.25u, mp3: 24->22, mn1: 8->10, cap: 0.8pF->0.6pF (saving 25% capacitor area), res: 9500->9400. Sizer to polish id=445 next in phase 4.

Polish phase 4 on RL best id=445 (FoM=0.6528, PM=60.69 deg, UGBW=106MHz). OP shows 1/gm6=501ohm, zero=29.8MHz (LHP), all devices saturated. Chosen lever: sweep res over 8800..9800 ohm around 9400 to find the optimal trade-off between resistor area and phase margin boost.

Polish phase 4 on RL best id=445 completed via sweeps on Rc: id=733 (res=8800, FoM=0.6731) and id=741 (res=8600, FoM=0.6801, best feasible!). Specs of id=741: area=8.694e-10 m^2, current=205.7uA, phm=62.72 deg, ugbw=100.1 MHz, SR=48.89 V/us. Rc=8600 is the optimal Pareto boundary; below 8600, UGBW drops below 100MHz.

RL round 2 completed: 190 simulations (50 warmup + 140 training). Total simulator calls reached 931 (>= total budget - 100). Replay buffer now contains 93 feasible designs covering a wide Pareto front (e.g. id=767 with gain=945V/V, FoM=0.6725). Best overall design remains id=741 with FoM=0.6801. Transitioning to final polish and review.

Review complete: best feasible candidate id=741, FoM=0.6801. Explanation written to harness_runs/harness_20261106_125536/explanation.md. Specs: gain=700.7 V/V, noise=0.0177 V RMS, phm=62.72 deg, slewRate=48.89 V/us, ugbw=100.1 MHz, current=205.7 uA, area=8.694e-10 m^2. Lineage, OP metrics (p2=31.8MHz, zero=32.8MHz), RL electric comparison, and trade-offs fully verified.
